arStrings.szText: {c_important}Unstable Currents{/c} now has a {c_number}[SF_4 * 100|%|]{/c} chance to trigger twice.

While {c_important}Unstable Currents{/c} is active, gain the following bonuses:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[SF_5 |1%|]{/c} chance to form a {u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u}
{icon:bullet,1.2} Increases {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill damage by {c_number}[SF_6 * 100|1%x|]{/c} and reduces {c_important}Unstable Currents'{/c} Cooldown by {c_number}[SF_7|2|]{/c} seconds when absorbing {u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u}.
{icon:bullet,1.2} Automatically absorb Nearby {c_important}{u}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u}.

{c_important}Unstable Currents{/c} now triggers equipped {c_important}Shock{/c} Skills that deal {c_number}[SF_10 * 100 |%x|]{/c} increased damage, but the same Skill cannot be triggered more than once every {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} second.
{c_important}Unstable Currents{/c} increases your Minimum and Maximum Ferocity by {c_number}{SF_11}{/c}.
{c_important}Unstable Currents'{/c} Cooldown is reduced to {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Unstable Currents{/c} increases your {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill damage by {c_number}[SF_13 * 100|%x|]{/c}.
{c_important}Unstable Currents{/c} reduces your Mana costs by {c_number}{SF_14}{/c}.
